decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposal would not result in harm to the appearance of the site and or harm to neighbouring premises in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and facilities for people with disabilities), E.1.3 (Location of General industry (B2) and storage and distribution (B8) uses), E.2.1 (Environmental criteria), E.2.3 Improvement of employment sites, E.2.4 (Improvement of employment premises), T.1.4 (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for developments), and Supplementary Planning Guidance of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - The approved internal first floor shall be used as a warehouse in connection with the authorised use of the rear part of the premises within Class B8 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification.
Condition : 6 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Alterations and extension to sides of pitched roof to form a higher flat roof to accommodate a new internal warehouse floor.
